howItWorks.title: How Findora Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Five simple steps to reunite lost belongings with their rightful owners safely.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Submit details, photos, and location of the lost or found item.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Smart similarity matching connects matching listings in real-time.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Verify ownership by answering unique questions or sharing proof.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Finder confirms the claim through safe, private verification.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Coordinate a safe handover spot and mark the item reunited.
